def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := by
  intro α β p _ x₀
  have h₁ : ∀ (a : α), Decidable (p a) := by
    intro a
    exact inferInstance
  -- Define the forward direction: from functions on α to functions on {a // ¬p a}
  have h₂ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → ({a // ¬p a} → β) := by
    intro ⟨x, hx⟩
    intro ⟨a, ha⟩
    have h₃ : ¬p a := ha
    have h₄ : p a → False := by intro h; exact h₃ h
    -- Since a is not in the domain of p, we can use x directly
    exact x a
  -- Define the inverse direction: from functions on {a // ¬p a} to functions on α
  have h₃ : ({a // ¬p a} → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } := by
    intro y
    have h₄ : ∃ (x : α → β), x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
      use fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h⟩
      ext ⟨a, ha⟩
      simp [ha]
      <;> aesop
    -- Use the function constructed above
    classical
    have h₅ : ∃ (x : α → β), x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := h₄
    refine' ⟨Classical.choose h₅, _⟩
    exact Classical.choose_spec h₅
  -- Construct the equivalence
  have h₄ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({a // ¬p a} → β) := by
    refine' ⟨h₂, h₃, _, _⟩
    · -- Prove that h₂ and h₃ are inverses in one direction
      intro ⟨x, hx⟩
      have h₅ : ∀ (a : α), (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) a) = x a := by
        intro a
        by_cases h₆ : p a
        · -- Case: p a is true
          have h₇ : (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) a) = x₀ ⟨a, h₆⟩ := by
            simp [h₆]
          have h₈ : x₀ ⟨a, h₆⟩ = x a := by
            have h₉ : (x ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, h₆⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, h₆⟩ := by
              apply hx
            simp [Function.comp_apply] at h₉ ⊢
            <;> exact h₉
          rw [h₇, h₈]
        · -- Case: p a is false
          have h₇ : (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) a) = (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) a := by
            simp [h₆]
          have h₈ : (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) a = x a := by
            have h₉ : (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) = x := by
              have h₁₀ : ∃ (x : α → β), x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
                use fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩
                ext ⟨a, ha⟩
                simp [ha]
                <;> aesop
              have h₁₁ : (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) = x := by
                have h₁₂ : ∃ (x : α → β), x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := h₁₀
                have h₁₃ : (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) = Classical.choose h₁₂ := by rfl
                have h₁₄ : Classical.choose h₁₂ ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := Classical.choose_spec h₁₂
                have h₁₅ : x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := hx
                have h₁₆ : ∀ (a : {a : α // p a}), Classical.choose h₁₂ a = x a := by
                  intro a
                  have h₁₇ : (Classical.choose h₁₂ ∘ Subtype.val) a = x₀ a := by
                    apply h₁₄
                  have h₁₈ : (x ∘ Subtype.val) a = x₀ a := by
                    apply hx
                  simp [Function.comp_apply] at h₁₇ h₁₈ ⊢
                  <;> simp_all
                  <;> aesop
                funext a
                by_cases h₁₉ : p a
                · -- Case: p a is true
                  have h₂₀ : Classical.choose h₁₂ a = x a := h₁₆ ⟨a, h₁₉⟩
                  simp_all [h₁₉]
                  <;> aesop
                · -- Case: p a is false
                  have h₂₀ : Classical.choose h₁₂ a = (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩ := by
                    have h₂₁ : Classical.choose h₁₂ a = (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
                      have h₂₂ : Classical.choose h₁₂ = (fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
                        apply funext
                        intro a
                        have h₂₃ : (Classical.choose h₁₂) a = (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
                          have h₂₄ : (Classical.choose h₁₂) ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := Classical.choose_spec h₁₂
                          have h₂₅ : x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := hx
                          by_cases h₂₆ : p a
                          · -- Case: p a is true
                            have h₂₇ : (Classical.choose h₁₂) a = x₀ ⟨a, h₂₆⟩ := by
                              have h₂₈ : (Classical.choose h₁₂ ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, h₂₆⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, h₂₆⟩ := by
                                apply Classical.choose_spec h₁₂
                              simp [Function.comp_apply] at h₂₈ ⊢
                              <;> simp_all
                              <;> aesop
                            simp_all [h₂₆]
                            <;> aesop
                          · -- Case: p a is false
                            have h₂₇ : (Classical.choose h₁₂) a = (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩ := by
                              have h₂₈ : (Classical.choose h₁₂) a = (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
                                have h₂₉ : (Classical.choose h₁₂) a = (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
                                  simp_all [h₂₆]
                                  <;> aesop
                                exact h₂₉
                              simp_all [h₂₆]
                              <;> aesop
                            simp_all [h₂₆]
                            <;> aesop
                        exact h₂₃
                      simp_all
                      <;> aesop
                    simp_all [h₁₉]
                    <;> aesop
                  simp_all [h₁₉]
                  <;> aesop
              simp_all
              <;> aesop
            simp_all
            <;> aesop
          rw [h₇, h₈]
      have h₆ : (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) = x := by
        have h₇ : ∀ (a : α), (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) a) = x a := h₅
        have h₈ : (h₃ (h₂ ⟨x, hx⟩)) = x := by
          funext a
          have h₉ := h₇ a
          by_cases h₁₀ : p a
          · -- Case: p a is true
            simp [h₁₀] at h₉ ⊢
            <;> have h₁₁ : x₀ ⟨a, h₁₀⟩ = x a := by
              have h₁₂ : (x ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, h₁₀⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, h₁₀⟩ := by
                apply hx
              simp [Function.comp_apply] at h₁₂ ⊢
              <;> exact h₁₂
            simp_all
          · -- Case: p a is false
            simp [h₁₀] at h₉ ⊢
            <;> simp_all
            <;> aesop
        exact h₈
      simp_all
      <;> aesop
    · -- Prove that h₂ and h₃ are inverses in the other direction
      intro y
      have h₅ : ∀ (⟨a, ha⟩ : {a // ¬p a}), (h₂ (h₃ y)) ⟨a, ha⟩ = y ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
        intro ⟨a, ha⟩
        have h₆ : ¬p a := ha
        have h₇ : (h₃ y) = (fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
          have h₈ : ∃ (x : α → β), x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
            use fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩
            ext ⟨a, ha⟩
            simp [ha]
            <;> aesop
          have h₉ : (h₃ y) = Classical.choose h₈ := by rfl
          have h₁₀ : Classical.choose h₈ ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := Classical.choose_spec h₈
          have h₁₁ : (fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
            ext ⟨a, ha⟩
            simp [ha]
            <;> aesop
          have h₁₂ : Classical.choose h₈ = (fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
            apply funext
            intro a
            have h₁₃ : (Classical.choose h₈) a = (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) := by
              have h₁₄ : (Classical.choose h₈ ∘ Subtype.val) = x₀ := by
                apply Classical.choose_spec
              have h₁₅ : ((fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) ∘ Subtype.val) = x₀ := by
                ext ⟨a, ha⟩
                simp [ha]
                <;> aesop
              by_cases h₁₆ : p a
              · -- Case: p a is true
                have h₁₇ : (Classical.choose h₈) a = x₀ ⟨a, h₁₆⟩ := by
                  have h₁₈ : (Classical.choose h₈ ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, h₁₆⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, h₁₆⟩ := by
                    apply Classical.choose_spec
                  simp [Function.comp_apply] at h₁₈ ⊢
                  <;> simp_all
                  <;> aesop
                have h₁₉ : (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) = x₀ ⟨a, h₁₆⟩ := by
                  simp [h₁₆]
                simp_all
                <;> aesop
              · -- Case: p a is false
                have h₁₇ : (Classical.choose h₈) a = y ⟨a, by tauto⟩ := by
                  have h₁₈ : (Classical.choose h₈ ∘ Subtype.val) = x₀ := by
                    apply Classical.choose_spec
                  have h₁₉ : ((fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) ∘ Subtype.val) = x₀ := by
                    ext ⟨a, ha⟩
                    simp [ha]
                    <;> aesop
                  simp_all [h₁₆]
                  <;> aesop
                have h₂₀ : (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) = y ⟨a, by tauto⟩ := by
                  simp [h₁₆]
                simp_all
                <;> aesop
            exact h₁₃
          simp_all
          <;> aesop
        simp_all [h₆]
        <;> aesop
      ext ⟨a, ha⟩
      have h₆ := h₅ ⟨a, ha⟩
      simp_all
      <;> aesop
  exact h₄
